input:
Earlier scenes:
(none)

This scene:
古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物，常常一吃就死。但是不知道为什么，没有办法。所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物，告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险。

The teacher's corrections on this scene (student words：her correction, her note):
- 古代时候，人不知道他们能吃什么植物：古代的时候，人们
- 所以有一天，神农出去试一试很多种植物：better to briefly introduce “神农” when this character first appears
- 告诉人什么植物是安全什么是危险：是安全的，是危险的
- 发现有的植物对身体非常好，特别是茶，让肚子感觉又暖和又清楚：add他in the beginning; delete 感觉，又暖和又舒服

The system's feedback items:
1. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 古代时候：古代的时候，A multi-syllable time expression before “时候” needs the particle “的”.
2. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 人不知道他们能吃什么植物：人们不知道什么植物能吃，Use “人们” for a concrete group of people; after this subject is stated, “他们” is unnecessary here.
3. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 试一试很多种植物：尝试很多种植物，“试一试” suggests trying something briefly, which does not fit testing many different kinds; “尝试” fits systematic testing.
4. [Grammar & Vocabulary, error] 什么植物是安全什么是危险：哪些植物是安全的，哪些植物是危险的，When an adjective follows “是” to describe a category, use “的”; “哪些……，哪些……” also makes the two groups parallel.
5. [Coherence: reference, error] Coherence (Reference): 神农：一个叫神农的人，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce the name with a full noun phrase rather than assuming the reader already knows who he is.
6. [Coherence: temporality, error] Coherence (Temporality): 告诉人们：告诉了人们，This is the final completed action in a series of past events, so it takes “了”; the earlier action in the series does not need another “了”.
7. [Coherence: connectors, error] Coherence (Conjunction): 但是不知道为什么，没有办法：因为不知道为什么，所以没有办法，Use “因为……所以……” for the cause-and-effect relation: not knowing the reason causes the lack of a solution.

items.reason: 古代 is multisyllabic, so 古代的时候 requires 的.
人 cannot refer to this concrete group; 人们 is required, and 他们 is unnecessary.
试一试很多种植物 is acceptable for Shennong trying or testing many plants, so this is only a stylistic rewrite.
The adjectives after 是 need 的: 是安全的 and 是危险的.
神农 is first mentioned here and should be introduced with a fuller noun phrase.
告诉 is the final completed action in the sequence, so it should take 了.
但是不知道为什么，没有办法 is understandable and acceptable here; the causal rewrite is not required.
